top_signals.title: Trezor shipping provider breach exposes personal data of nearly 14,000 customers
top_signals.summary: Trezor said a ShipMonk breach exposed the personal data of nearly 14,000 hardware wallet customers, including some shipping addresses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 'Big Short' investor Steve Eisman sees an Achilles' heel in the AI boom
top_signals.summary: Steve Eisman is warning that the artificial intelligence boom has become increasingly dependent on the fortunes of just two companies: OpenAI and Anthropic.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tyson to Close More Beef Plants as US Cattle Shortage Drags On
top_signals.summary: Tyson Foods Inc. said it would close several additional beef plants, in the latest sign of the US beefpacking industry’s restructuring amid a prolonged US cattle shortage.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: UAE, Qatari Firms Debut in Venezuela Through BP-Led Gas Deal
top_signals.summary: Arab Gulf companies are making their debut in Venezuela through an offshore natural gas project to be operated by BP Plc.
